name: Test Orchestrated
description: Minimal, reachable orchestrated template for end-to-end verification. Expands a `urls` array into one seed per URL, fetches each page via a cheerio scrape, extracts a single item (title + first paragraph), and writes it to a Dataset. No pagination or detail requests.

urls.label: URLs
urls.description: Reachable pages to scrape. The seedHandler emits one seed per URL (seedKey = array index).

reviewNotes: Minimal orchestrated smoke-test template (seed fan-out + single-item page handler).
